# [TASK] Distributed tracing: Micrometer Tracing + Zipkin across all services

## Task
Add distributed tracing (Micrometer Tracing + Zipkin, ADR-007) across all backend services (gateway, discovery, config, movie-service, actor-service, ai-service, user-service).

## Scope
`media-service` is excluded — it's currently a stub with no real request path worth tracing yet.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Gateway, discovery, config, movie-service, actor-service, ai-service, and user-service all build with tracing dependencies (`micrometer-tracing-bridge-brave`, `zipkin-reporter-brave`) and export spans to a local Zipkin instance
- [x] Zipkin UI shows one trace spanning gateway -> movie-service -> TMDB client on a cold cache miss
- [x] Zipkin UI shows a cache-hit trace with no TMDB client span
- [x] Trace/span IDs appear in each service's JSON log output (`logback-spring.xml` MDC configuration)
- [x] Trace context survives the gateway's reactive (WebFlux) filters

## Estimate
**Hours:** 10

## Notes
- Zipkin container configured in `docker-compose.yml` (port 9411) and Kubernetes local overlay (`infrastructure/kubernetes/overlays/local/zipkin.yaml`).
- Sampling rate configured via `TRACING_SAMPLE_RATE` (default 1.0 / 100% locally).
